title: Knowledge Check 2: Lessons 9-16
description: Questions pooled from Lessons 9-16 of the salesforce-architect series. Score 80% or higher to progress toward the practice exam.

questions.question: Per the lesson “Integration Reliability: Idempotency, Retries, Error Handling, and Dead-Letter Design”, what is the central focus?
options: The reliability toolkit every integration needs: idempotency keys and message IDs so retries are safe, the transient vs.

questions.question: Per the lesson “Data Architecture: Data Model Design, Common Data Model Patterns, and Data Skew”, what is the central focus?
options: Data is the load-bearing wall of every org. Designing a data model that scales means deciding where each relationship lives, recognizing the recurring shapes that solve real problems, and keeping the load off any single parent record or owner.
A history of the technology and its vendors
A review of unrelated productivity tools
A summary of corporate policy rules
questions.explanation: The lesson is centered on: Data is the load-bearing wall of every org. Designing a data model that scales means deciding where each relationship lives, recognizing the recurring shapes that solve real problems, and keeping the load off any single parent record or owner. This lesson covers data model design, the common patterns (one-to-many, many-to-many, hierarchical, and data tiering), and the three data skews that quietly break performance.
